verdict.rationale: The docs describe dedicated extract_header and extract_footer parameters that return headers and footers in separate fields. They also describe an include_blocks option that returns paragraph-level blocks with structural labels and content in reading order. Community testers praise its PDF-to-markdown accuracy, though one hands-on report says a whole page was returned as a single image instead of text. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of multi-column layout handling, footnote detection or separation, and consistent independent corroboration of correct ordering on complex layouts.
